 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the populated panel's pattern into every cell of the divider grid."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    divider = 4

    # Full-width/full-height divider lines partition the canvas into panels.
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in g[r])]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 < c1:
                panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))

    # The background is the most frequent value inside panels; the source
    # panel is the one containing the most non-background marks.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(g[r][c] for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(
        g[r][c] != background
        for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])
    ))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in g[sr0:sr1]]

    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        if (r1 - r0, c1 - c0) != (len(pattern), len(pattern[0])):
            continue
        for dr in range(r1 - r0):
            for dc in range(c1 - c0):
                g[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return g
